example: Thank you so much for your help.
exampleTranslation: 非常感谢你的帮助。

example: Please wait for me at the school gate.
exampleTranslation: 请在校门口等我。

example: The waiter brought our food quickly.
exampleTranslation: 服务员很快把食物端来了。

example: I wake up at seven every morning.
exampleTranslation: 我每天早上七点醒来。

example: I want a glass of water, please.
exampleTranslation: 我想要一杯水。

example: Can you show me the way to the zoo?
exampleTranslation: 你能告诉我去动物园的路吗？

example: We have a football match next week.
exampleTranslation: 我们下周有一场足球赛。

example: She was ill yesterday but feels well today.
exampleTranslation: 她昨天生病了，但今天感觉很好。

example: Where did you put the classroom key?
exampleTranslation: 你把教室钥匙放在哪里了？

example: I went to the library with my cousin.
exampleTranslation: 我和表弟一起去了图书馆。

example: We had a wonderful day at the beach.
exampleTranslation: 我们在海滩度过了美好的一天。

example: Mum was worried when I came home late.
exampleTranslation: 我回家晚时妈妈很担心。

example: Do not worry; we still have enough time.
exampleTranslation: 别担心，我们还有足够的时间。

example: Wow, your model plane can really fly!
exampleTranslation: 哇，你的模型飞机真的能飞！

example: Yeah, I would love to join the game.
exampleTranslation: 好啊，我很愿意参加这个游戏。

example: You can sit beside me.
exampleTranslation: 你可以坐在我旁边。

example: The young bird is learning to fly.
exampleTranslation: 这只幼鸟正在学习飞翔。

example: Please write your name on the card.
exampleTranslation: 请把你的名字写在卡片上。

example: This blue umbrella is yours.
exampleTranslation: 这把蓝色雨伞是你的。

example: Our music club meets on Friday.
exampleTranslation: 我们的音乐社团星期五活动。

example: School begins again on Monday.
exampleTranslation: 学校星期一重新开课。

example: We visit the market on Saturday.
exampleTranslation: 我们星期六去市场。

example: The family has lunch together on Sunday.
exampleTranslation: 全家星期日一起吃午饭。

example: We have science class on Thursday.
exampleTranslation: 我们星期四上科学课。

example: The swimming lesson is on Tuesday.
exampleTranslation: 游泳课在星期二。

example: My schoolbag is heavier than yours.
exampleTranslation: 我的书包比你的重。

example: This stone is heavy, but that one is heavier.
exampleTranslation: 这块石头很重，但那块更重。

example: Our hotel is close to the railway station.
exampleTranslation: 我们的旅馆离火车站很近。

example: How about going to the museum tomorrow?
exampleTranslation: 明天去博物馆怎么样？

example: Hurry up, or the school bus will leave.
exampleTranslation: 快点，否则校车要开走了。

example: My knee hurts now because I hurt it yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我的膝盖现在疼，因为昨天受伤了。

example: We used the Internet to find information about whales.
exampleTranslation: 我们利用互联网查找有关鲸鱼的资料。

example: A small boat took us to the island.
exampleTranslation: 一艘小船把我们送到岛上。

example: The children are jumping over a rope.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们正在跳绳。

example: Please keep your desk clean and tidy.
exampleTranslation: 请保持课桌干净整洁。

example: Cyclists should keep to the right on this road.
exampleTranslation: 骑车人在这条路上应该靠右行驶。

example: We keep our desks clean every day.
exampleTranslation: 我们每天保持课桌整洁。

example: The kitten is sleeping in a basket.
exampleTranslation: 小猫正在篮子里睡觉。

example: Our school is closed on Labour Day.
exampleTranslation: 劳动节我们学校放假。

example: We helped clean the park on Labour Day.
exampleTranslation: 劳动节我们帮忙清理了公园。

example: Everyone laughed at the funny picture.
exampleTranslation: 大家看到那张有趣的图片都笑了。

example: We laugh at his jokes, and we laughed a lot yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我们会因他的笑话发笑，昨天笑了很久。

example: A red leaf fell from the tree.
exampleTranslation: 一片红叶从树上落下。

example: I wrote a letter to my pen friend.
exampleTranslation: 我给笔友写了一封信。

example: The puppy licked my hand.
exampleTranslation: 小狗舔了我的手。

example: Dogs sometimes lick people; this puppy licked my hand.
exampleTranslation: 狗有时会舔人，这只小狗舔了我的手。

example: We are listening to music in the classroom.
exampleTranslation: 我们正在教室里听音乐。

example: Listening to music helps me relax.
exampleTranslation: 听音乐能帮助我放松。

example: The blue ruler is longer than the red one.
exampleTranslation: 蓝尺子比红尺子长。

example: This rope is long, but that rope is longer.
exampleTranslation: 这根绳子很长，但那根更长。

example: Look up the new word in your dictionary.
exampleTranslation: 在词典里查这个生词。

example: This wall is low, but the fence is lower.
exampleTranslation: 这堵墙很低，但篱笆更低。

example: The swimming pool is twenty-five metres long.
exampleTranslation: 游泳池长二十五米。

example: Two mice ran behind the cupboard.
exampleTranslation: 两只老鼠跑到了橱柜后面。

example: The new shoes are much more comfortable.
exampleTranslation: 新鞋舒服多了。

example: The mule carried bags up the mountain.
exampleTranslation: 骡子把行李驮上山。

example: The national flag flew above the school.
exampleTranslation: 国旗在学校上空飘扬。

example: We watched the flag-raising ceremony on National Day.
exampleTranslation: 国庆日我们观看了升旗仪式。

example: No problem, I can help you carry the box.
exampleTranslation: 没问题，我可以帮你搬箱子。

example: These noodles taste good with vegetables.
exampleTranslation: 这些面条配蔬菜很好吃。

example: There is nothing in the empty bag.
exampleTranslation: 空袋子里什么也没有。

example: The lesson starts at eight o'clock.
exampleTranslation: 课程八点开始。

example: We eat lunch at twelve o'clock.
exampleTranslation: 我们十二点吃午饭。

example: This is a map of China.
exampleTranslation: 这是一张中国地图。
